subject: history_timesplit.jsonl read (2dc8868)
body: history_text now reads history_timesplit.jsonl (via timesplit.HISTORY; heldout_timesplit.jsonl is never read). Note: for Hobbhahn the choices alone are ~390k chars, but the prompt arm pastes only the first 8000 by default. That's now --history-chars, and E4.json lists the amount as a [decide] item. Separately: corpus/ documents are pasted with no cutoff, while the R1-S model uses docs_before(cutoff). Should the prompt arm also stop at the cutoff? Tell me which and I'll match it.
